data.title: Portugal move into Nations League knockout stage, Germany held
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Portugal became the first team to reach the quarter-finals of the Nations League when they beat Norway 2-1 on Sunday, but Jurgen Klopp's Germany were frustrated by Greece.

data.title: 'Gambler' Hudson ready to roll the dice once again
data.description: Thailand coach Anthony Hudson, pressed over his rotation policy, says he would make the same gamble again as his men face hosts Indonesia in tonight's inaugural Fifa Asean Cup final.

data.title: Cyclists turn Nagoya blank into fuel for Olympic push
data.description: Thailand's cyclists leave the Asian Games in Nagoya without a medal, but with a sharper sense of what it will take to reach the 2028 Olympics, and with enough ranking points banked to keep realistic hopes alive on road, track and BMX.

data.title: Eighteen gold, and a record away haul
data.description: Thailand arrived in Nagoya with a target of 14 gold medals. They left with 18, and a place in the record books.

data.title: Israel wear black armbands in Ireland tie over Hamas attack
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel's national football team wore black armbands in their Nations League clash against Ireland on Sunday to commemorate the victims of Hamas' October 7, 2023 attack, after Irish players wore them to protest the war in Gaza.

data.title: Teen titans shine in chaotic Games
data.description: NAGOYA: The 20th Asian Games closed yesterday after a rocky fortnight lit up by youthful brilliance in the sporting arenas but tempered by ‌logistical dysfunction and subdued public interest.

data.title: 10 fans injured when car ploughs into NRL final crowd in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY -  A car crashed into a crowd of rugby league supporters in the eastern Australian city of Newcastle on Satureday, injuring ten people, three of them children, local officials said.

data.title: South Korean flag glitch sees Asian Games end on sour note
data.description: TOYOTA CITY, Japan - South Korea's Asian Games football captain called it "disappointing" after the country's flag appeared to get stuck during the victory ceremony following their win over hosts Japan.

data.title: Wake-up call! Forward Kristensen's double rocks rotated Thailand
data.description: Thailand's preparations for the Fifa Asean Cup final suffered a jolt on Friday night, when a heavily rotated side lost 2-1 to the Philippines in their final Group B fixture at Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung.

data.title: Another slice of history for teen Thai skater Hiro
data.description: Hiro Kaewtathip made history again by winning Thailand's first-ever gold medal at the ISU Figure Skating Junior Grand Prix.

data.title: Star Puripol crowned the Asiad MVP
data.description: Star sprinter Puripol Boonson has been selected by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) as the Most Valuable Player (MVP) of the 20th Asian Games after delivering a spectacular performance on the track in Japan.

data.title: Memorable Thai performance yields 18 gold medals
data.description: Taekwondo star Banlung Tubtimdang, sailor Pinchanok Klaysomboon and jiu-jitsu fighter Orapa Senatham each stood atop the podium on Saturday, powering Thailand’s gold medal haul to 18 on the penultimate day of the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: ONE Championship: Shamil Erdogan demands title shot, calls out retired Anatoly Malykhin
data.description: Shamil Erdogan challenged Anatoly Malykhin to come out of retirement after strengthening his claim to ONE Championship’s vacant heavyweight MMA title with a second-round submission of Paul Elliott.

data.title: India beat Pakistan in cricket blockbuster
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - India beat arch-rivals Pakistan to win Asian Games gold on Saturday in a blockbuster cricket final as South Korea’s Tom Kim clinched the men’s golf crown — and will avoid military service.

data.title: ONE Championship: Dzhamil Osmanov dismantles Ben Woolliss to earn US$100,000 contract
data.description: Dzhamil Osmanov dismantled Ben Woolliss with three knockdowns in 84 seconds to earn a US$100,000 ONE Championship contract and join older brother Elbrus on the promotion’s main roster.

data.title: ONE Championship: Eersel, Jarvis reunite in hospital after ‘fight of the year’ thriller
data.description: Regian Eersel and George Jarvis both ended up in hospital after a brutal ONE Championship title fight, with the champion revealing a broken right arm and the English challenger saying he had fractured his eye socket.

data.title: Thailand’s Jeeno tied for lead at Hawaii event
data.description: HONOLULU, Hawaii - Jeeno ​Thitikul of Thailand and Polly ⁠Mack of Germany each ⁠birdied the final hole on Friday ​to share the lead after the second round of the Lotte Championship in Honolulu.

data.title: Royals fans still love their gem now worth his weight in gold
data.description: For many years, supporters of lower league clubs in England have become resigned to witnessing their most promising players being snapped up by bigger clubs for relatively small sums. It is very frustrating for the fans, but it's the way the system works.

data.title: Veteran Worawut to lead boccia team at Para Games
data.description: Three-time world champion Worawut Saengampa will lead Thailand's boccia team at the forthcoming Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, which run from 18 to 24 Oct.

data.title: Man City launch appeal against explosive financial ruling
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City confirmed on Friday that they had launched an appeal against a damning judgement that found the club guilty of more than 100 charges related to serious breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules.

data.title: Three more golds help Thailand surpass target
data.description: Thailand’s women made a splash on the water and a statement on the sand and in the boxing ring at the Asian Games, as a three-gold haul on Friday took the Kingdom to 15 golds in Aichi-Nagoya, one better than its target of 14.

data.title: ONE Championship: Eersel, Jarvis make weight for lightweight Muay Thai title rematch
data.description: George Jarvis’s second shot at Regian Eersel’s ONE Championship lightweight Muay Thai world title is set for Friday night after both cleared weight and hydration for The Inner Circle 33.

data.title: Not-so-brave new world: virtual taekwondo makes Asian Games debut
data.description: TOYOHASHI (JAPAN) - Taekwondo dates back more than 2,000 years, but on Friday at the Asian Games the Korean martial art stepped into a not-so-brave future where nobody gets hurt: virtual taekwondo.

data.title: Ronaldo's Portugal future in doubt after walkout
data.description: COPENHAGEN - The international future of Portugal superstar Cristiano Ronaldo hung in the balance after the 41-year-old walked out on the squad after learning that he would not start the game against Denmark on Thursday.

data.title: Ireland game interrupted twice by Gaza protests
data.description: DUBLIN - The Nations League football match between Ireland and Austria in Dublin on Thursday was twice briefly interrupted by demonstrations in support of Palestine.

data.title: Portugal edge Denmark in Ronaldo's absence
data.description: COPENHAGEN - Portugal put the controversy surrounding Cristiano Ronaldo's departure to one side as they edged Denmark 4-2 in the Uefa Nations League on Thursday.

data.title: War Elephants meet Azkals
data.description: Thailand have already booked their place in the final of the inaugural Fifa Asean Cup, but Anthony Hudson's side will still be chasing a flawless Group B campaign when they face the Philippines at the Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung on Friday.

data.title: Poomsae prodigies lead the charge
data.description: Thailand's young guns came out kicking at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya on Thursday as poomsae artists Navin Pinthasute and Thitaree Kaewolanwasu each landed a medal on the opening day of taekwondo, while a canoeist and a teenage jiu-jitsu fighter also swelled the Thai tally.

data.title: Spotlight on UK-UAE ties amid Manchester City scandal
data.description: LONDON - The Manchester City financial scandal threatens to tarnish one of Abu Dhabi's most dazzling showcases of "soft power" and confronts the United Kingdom with a delicate balancing act in preserving its long-standing ties with the Emirates.

data.title: India and Pakistan to clash for Asia Games cricket gold
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - India and arch-rivals Pakistan will clash for Asian Games cricket gold as Philippines tennis trailblazer Alexandra Eala suffered a shock semi-final exit on Thursday in Japan.

data.title: Man City scandal could taint Premier League brand
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - The Premier League has won a lengthy legal battle with Manchester City over financial impropriety, but the consequences could leave lasting damage for a league that has long since become the envy of world football.

data.title: ONE Championship: Lee Seung Cheol bout off over Karen Ghazaryan’s visa delays
data.description: South Korea’s Lee Seung Cheol has had his push towards a ONE Championship strawweight MMA title shot interrupted, with his bout against Karen Ghazaryan pulled from this weekend’s ONE Fight Night 48 card.
